ESTIMAND.PRIMARY_ESTIMAND: beta_CY = d log d_CY / d log L, with d_CY(L) = median_{frames in window} |C - Y|  /  pred(L), where pred(L) is the operator's exact finite-size prediction of |C - Y| at that L
ESTIMAND.C: toroidal Frechet centre of the X field: the separable exact minimiser of the sum of squared toroidal distances, computed axis by axis, on a lattice site (metrics_obtc.frechet_centre)
ESTIMAND.Y: the unique cell with n_Y > 0 (one organiser), read from the same frame
ESTIMAND.TORIC_DISTANCE: hypot(wdist1(dy, L), wdist1(dx, L)), wdist1(d,L)=min(d%L, L-d%L)
ESTIMAND.PER_FRAME_SUMMARY: |C - Y| of that frame, field name organiser_to_core
ESTIMAND.WITHIN_SEED_SUMMARY: the MEDIAN of |C - Y| over the 180 in-window frames of the arm (steps strictly after the burn-in, one frame every SAMPLE_EVERY steps), where |C - Y| is the toroidal Euclidean distance between the Frechet centre of the X field and the organiser cell, both read from the same frame
ESTIMAND.LOG_TRANSFORM: y_L = mean over analysable arms of log(summary) - log(pred(L))
ESTIMAND.REGRESSION: weighted least squares slope of y_L = mean_arms(log summary) - log(prediction_L) on log L, weights w_L = n_L / sd_L(log summary)^2
ESTIMAND.EXTINCTION_TREATMENT: an extinction consumes its seed and is never replaced, never rerun, and never deleted as a missing observation
ESTIMAND.LOW_POPULATION_TREATMENT: NONE. The frozen definition of an analysable arm is only 'finite and strictly positive summary'. No population floor exists in the freeze.
ESTIMAND.INTERVAL_METHOD: TOST in confidence-interval form: the whole two-sided (1 - 2 alpha) interval for beta_CY must lie strictly inside +- margin
ESTIMAND.AGGREGATED_RULE: PASS if and only if the whole 90 % interval lies inside the margin. A point estimate near zero does not qualify. Excluding H_linear does not qualify. Excluding H_sublinear does not qualify.

HISTORICAL_INTERVAL_FOR_CONTRAST.note: the 99.49 % interval OBDI01 used, applied to the OBDI02 data for contrast only; it is not the frozen OBDI02 rule

EFFECT_SIZE_OVER_THE_RANGE.reading: the frozen margin 0.25 admits growth up to a factor 1.278 over the tested range; the secondary target 0.042 admits 1.042; the observed point estimate is 1.084 and its 90 % interval runs from 1.010 to 1.164
